notes: Reference pool for Sill builder.py. Self-train entries point to files inside this dir (stable, compile-verified). MindGarden entries point to absolute iCloud paths so Quinn's edits flow through without re-copying. The loader (builder.py:load_references) picks 1 compile-correctness anchor from self_train + 1 style anchor from mindgarden per build, biased by tag match against the goal text. If a MindGarden path is missing (iCloud not synced), that entry is silently skipped.

references.name: decay-memory-fragments
references.description: Memory fragments that decay on hover. Warm earth-tone palette (#26201A base, cream text), serif typography, timer-driven decay rate. Single-file ContentView with Identifiable structs, full Color(red:green:blue:) literal usage, GeometryReader + ZStack composition. Canonical example of Sill's thematic territory (items fading over time).

references.name: identifiable-ripples
references.description: Identifiable Fear structs positioned via CGPoint, dark gradient background (Color(red: 0.05, green: 0.05, blue: 0.08)), rippling circles with stroke opacity decay. Demonstrates clean Identifiable conformance, explicit Color literals, ForEach with index patterns.

references.name: circular-dial
references.description: Temperature negotiation dial. Demonstrates Circle + trim + AngularGradient + StrokeStyle composition, Color(hue:saturation:brightness:) literal usage, inner ConversationEntry: Identifiable pattern, large .system font weight composition.

references.name: attractive-button-style
references.description: Quinn's preferred button aesthetic: frosted glass with layered LinearGradient + RadialGradient overlays, RoundedRectangle stroke masks, .sensoryFeedback, spring animations. Shows how to build rich materials from stacked SwiftUI primitives without hex literals. WON'T COMPILE STANDALONE (depends on frosted-glass-texture asset + CoreMotion) — use as STYLE anchor only.

references.name: custom-header-view
references.description: Minimal header component with chevron.left back button and close button. Demonstrates compact HStack composition, SF Symbol usage, circular button backgrounds. Closest MindGarden analog to Sill's menubar header treatment. WON'T COMPILE STANDALONE (depends on ColorStore @EnvironmentObject).

references.name: emotional-processing-view
references.description: Conditional section rendering based on data presence. Shows Quinn's patterns for VStack with spacing: 20, section headers with icons, tag layouts, rounded backgrounds (Color.secondary.opacity(0.1), cornerRadius 10). WON'T COMPILE STANDALONE (depends on ColorStore, custom font extensions, data models).
